- Epoch dial: about 1–2 (E046 vs E049: 0.12 s for about 0.0–0.15 pp).
- Group-2 freeze at 90%: near free. At 85% it trades at the dial's rate.
- Stem freeze: 75% is near optimal. 71% (E055) and 60% (E037) are worse than the dial.

W3 (cost lens), after E056.

**Tip (E049, 3df6233).** 237 steps at batch 2000; 20/24/28/32 px at 30/10/30/30%; whitening detached at 20%; stem frozen at 75%; group-2 annealed from 75% and frozen at 90%. Two builds read 0.7535/5.198 s and 0.7552/5.206 s. Population mean is about 0.7535 (my estimate, unselected). That leaves about 0.3 pp over the 0.75 bar before judge and rebuild drift.

**Noise.**
- Per-seed SD is about 0.3 pp. A 3-seed mean has SE of about 0.17 pp, plus rebuild drift. E036's four reads spanned 0.7497–0.7544.
- I expect rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean (σ_build) to be about 0.08–0.15 pp, correlated across seeds.
- Time reproduces to about 1%.
- Seeds 0–2 can't resolve effects under about 0.25 pp.

**Time model.** Time ≈ 0.25 s + Σ(steps × per-step cost).
- Per-step cost: 32 px 0.032 s, 28 px 0.026 s, 24 px 0.021 s, 20 px 0.016 s.
- The stem freeze saves about 0.0087 s per step at 32 px. The group-2 freeze saves about 0.010 s more.
- Correction from my misses: E046, E052 and E056 all came in faster than I forecast (about 2–3% below my point). I now bias cuts and removals about 2% faster than the MAC/step model says.
- The ReLU swap (E056) saved about 4.7%, more than I expected, but cost about 0.2 pp.

**Exchange rates (s saved per pp lost).**
- Epoch dial: about 1–2 (E046 vs E049: 0.12 s for about 0.0–0.15 pp).
- Group-2 freeze at 90%: near free. At 85% it trades at the dial's rate.
- Stem freeze: 75% is near optimal. 71% (E055) and 60% (E037) are worse than the dial.
- ReLU: about 1.2 (E056), close to the dial, so it is not a free win.
- Width: about 0.7. Stride instead of pool: about 0.45.

**Mechanisms.**
1. Accuracy is bought with optimizer steps on layers that are still learning (E041, E045, E053, E054, E055).
2. Lookahead is worth about 1 pp and is tuned (E025 and E030 both hurt).
3. The late 28/32 px phases carry accuracy. The early phases are step-limited, not pixel-limited.
4. Filter wd is inert because Muon renormalizes the filters every step (p.mul_ in muon_update). Only the SGD-group wd matters.
5. BN scale is already frozen (`BatchNorm.__init__` sets `weight.requires_grad=False`). H1.5.10 closes from the code.
6. The harness passes only fine labels (`data.labels`). Coarse labels would need an external mapping table, so H1.8 is blocked.
7. Under Muon, ||ΔW||/||W|| for filters is set by the LR schedule: the norm is fixed and the update is orthogonalized. Update-rate curves will just redraw the imposed schedules and can't predict freeze cost.
8. The whitening-detach move from 20% to 6% saves at most about 0.05–0.08 s, below rebuild time noise.

**Strategy.**
- The remaining value is in gate accounting (I088/I089/I090), not in new levers.
- If σ_build is about 0.1 pp, the frozen gate needs μ̂ of about 0.7522–0.7525. E052 and E053, which I expect at about 0.7515–0.752 on fresh seeds, probably fail. E046 is borderline.
- E049 itself might be only marginally safe. In that case the dial runs the other way: spend steps.

**Unsure.**
- The size of σ_build.
- Winner's curse vs seed-set difficulty on seeds 13–32.
- Whether E052, E053 or E046 clears the gate on seeds 33–52.
- Whether judge-PCIe kernel reselection adds drift beyond 0.05 pp.

forecasts.reason: No recipe change. E036's 3-seed reads spread about 0.47 pp, more than seed noise explains, which points to a correlated build component of at least 0.08 pp.
Expected fresh-seed population is about 0.7515–0.752 for E052/E053. With σ_build about 0.1, P(official ≥0.75) falls below 0.9 for at least one of them.
The Δtime of about 0.12 s will fit the prediction, but a Δacc of 0.06–0.18 pp can't be resolved once σ_build is added to the SE.
The harness supplies only fine labels, so the step-0 rules check will block the run. Numbers are the tip if anything is run.
The BatchNorm class already sets weight.requires_grad=False, so this closes on the code read with no change.
About 33 extra detached steps at 20/24 px save about 1–2 ms each (≤0.07 s). The accuracy effect is near zero and below 20-seed plus build resolution.
Muon's fixed-norm, orthogonalized updates make ||ΔW||/||W|| track the imposed LR schedule. The curves will not separate E028 from E037/E055 beyond restating the schedule.

cruxes: What is σ_build for a 20-seed mean (I088)? Near 0.04 pp means E052/E053-class recipes (about 0.7515) pass the gate and the ~5.0 s tier opens. Near 0.15 pp means even E049 is marginal, and steps should be bought back, not cut.
Is E049's fresh-seed (33–52) mean about 0.7535, or about 0.752 (winner's curse)? This sets how much margin is left to spend on any cut.
Does the post-freeze epoch dial (E046 vs E049 on the same fresh seeds) cost under 1 s/pp? If it does, every remaining lever, including ReLU at about 1.2 s/pp, is worse than simply trimming epochs.
